description: ST7735S 1.8" 128x160 TFT on SPI1 (PA5 SCK, PA7 MOSI, 9 MHz) with PA4 CS, PB0 DC, PB1 RES, PB10 BL: black-tab init, eight colour bars and text, frame counter every 500 ms
expect:
72 MHz. SPI1 master transmit-only, mode 0, MSB first, 8-bit, prescaler 8: SCK 9 MHz on PA5, MOSI PA7 (AF push-pull). GPIO push-pull: PA4 = CS (idle high), PB0 = DC, PB1 = RES, PB10 = BL. USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1. Prints 'ST7735 TFT demo
'; RES low 10 ms, high 120 ms; SWRESET + 150 ms, SLPOUT + 120 ms, FRMCTR1-3 (01 2C 2D), INVCTR 07, PWCTR1-5, VMCTR1 0E, INVOFF, MADCTL C0h, COLMOD 05h, CASET 0..127, RASET 0..159, GMCTRP1 / GMCTRN1, NORON + 10 ms, DISPON + 100 ms, BL high; prints 'ST7735 ready
'. Each command / parameter group is one CS-low window, DC low for the command byte. Picture (RGB565 big-endian after RAMWR in CASET/RASET windows): rows 0..99 = eight 16 px bars left to right FFFF, FFE0, 07FF, 07E0, F81F, F800, 001F, 0000; rows 100..159 black with 'ST7735 128x160' at (4,108) white; prints 'colour bars drawn
' (about 41 KB of SPI data, 40 ms). Every 500 ms (deadline based) 'frame N' (N = 1, 2, ...) is redrawn at (4,124) in yellow on black, 6x8 cells of a 5x7 font; every 2nd time 'frame N
' on USART1.

circuit: PA5, PA7, PA4, PB0, PB1, PB10: unconnected on this bench (TFT SCL / SDA / CS / DC / RES / BL in the full circuit; the picture is covered by tests/devices/displays-firmware.test.ts)
USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)

boot.USART1:
ST7735 TFT demo
ST7735 ready
colour bars drawn
